featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited their new upcoming project on 22 Dec 2025. They are charging Rs 1.40 crores for a 2bhk flat with an area of 825 sq ft. Once I heard this price for a flat in a building located in Vasai Gaon, I had to call an ambulance as I suffered a heart attack. Never got a bigger shock in my life. How can a builder quote such a maddening price for a flat located in Vasai Gaon? This is unacceptable. Why will one buy a flat worth 1.40 crores in Vasai gaon whereas one can buy a flat in Borivali, Thane or Navi Mumbai in the same price. This is really a joke. The builder thinks that people who come to buy the flats are idiots.

Responding to the reply from the builder:

No amount of amenities can justify the rate you are quoting. You can't build an apartment with amenities in a desert and sell it for a price worth gold. It just doesn't make sense. Amenities matter when the location is right. For a flat in a village, you are quoting 1.5 CR. This amounts to fraud. No one will buy your flats unless you reduce the price. I won't even buy your flat for 50 lakhs. It's not even worth that amount. I think 25 lakhs is the max that you should quote for a flat in an isolated, underdeveloped and shady place like Vasai gaon
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

Thank you for visiting us recently. Our team was delighted to host you and walk you through the apartment you enquired about  a high-rise residence on the 19th floor with expansive views.

We also firmly believe that the standard of living in Vasai has evolved significantly. Today’s homebuyers here are discerning, aspirational, and comfortable investing in well-planned, high-quality residential developments that enhance everyday living.

imagine living in Vasai, on a high floor, in a spacious home with beautiful views, seamless access to some of the best cafés and restaurants around, strong safety systems, a play area for children, and a pool for those well-earned moments of relaxation. That said, every homebuyer has their own priorities, and we respect your perspective. Thank you for visiting us and sharing your thoughts. We wish you good health.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Great project, but sales transparency needs improvement

The Positives:
1. Exceptional Construction Quality & Design: The project lives up to Shapoorji Pallonji’s reputation with robust construction, spacious layouts, and premium finishes like vitrified tiles, laminated doors, and branded fittings . The towers are well-planned, and the Goan-themed architecture adds a unique charm .

2. Breathtaking Views & Peaceful Environment: Residents enjoy serene greenery, palm-lined avenues, and scenic balconies—perfect for a relaxed lifestyle . The location near beaches (Rajodi, Arnala) is a bonus .

3. Top-Notch Amenities: The project offers 25+ amenities, including a swimming pool, gym, clubhouse, jogging track, and even a skating rink . The water treatment plant and solar facilities highlight sustainability efforts .

The Negatives (Sales Process Issues):
1.  Misleading Commitments by Sales Team : Our salesperson, **Mandeep Pandey**, made false promises:
Kitchen Trolley Assured it would be installed by the builder but wasn’t delivered.

- Hidden Charges - Claims like "free AC bus service, banquet hall, and mini-theatre included in maintenance" were untrue these incur extra costs . *Tip for buyers*: Negotiate to remove unwanted services (e.g., bus cost) from the cost sheet.

2. Pressure Tactics & Fake Urgency The team created artificial demand ("Last 4 flats left!") to rush decisions. Always verify availability independently and take time to evaluate .

3. Cash Payment Demand : The relationship manager Mr rakesh parekh insisted on ₹10,000 cash for "legal fees" during registration, refusing digital payment a red flag for transparency.

Final Verdict
Joyville Virar is a stellar project for its construction, amenities, and lifestyle . However, proceed cautiously with sales discussions
- Document all promises in writing.
- Scrutinize cost breakdowns for hidden charges.
- Avoid rushed decisions under pressure.

Recommendation : Ideal for families seeking a peaceful, well-equipped home—just ensure you cross-check every sales claim

​I am writing this as a two-time investor with Sunteck Realty to warn others: Do not be fooled by the marketing. My experience across two different projects has been a series of broken commitments and zero accountability.
​Project 1: Sunteck Maxxworld (Naigaon)
Operational Negligence: My electricity bill has been incorrectly mapped to another flat since possession in April 2025. Despite 10+ months of follow-ups, Sunteck refuses to fix this.
Zero Accountability: Even after escalating to the grievance team and Mr. Sanjay Kumar Kanojia, there has been total radio silence.
​Missing Infrastructure: OC was obtained and maintenance handed over without basic necessities like Municipality water or a Sewage Treatment Plant (STP).
​​Project 2: Sunteck Beach Residences SBR (Vasai)
​Bait and Switch: The sales team promised a high-elevation beach view with 4 podium levels. Now, CRM (Chanda) confirms there is no podium and the view is primarily of the city.
​Lack of Transparency: When asked to put these revised plans in writing via email, the CRM team refused to commit.
​Don't be blinded by their fancy brochures. While investing they had shown the drone views and shared the snippet of the actual view which we would be getting from the flat. And now they are not commiting to the same view.
Dikhao pe na jao, apni akal ladao.
They take your money and stop responding. Save yourself the stress and be cautious before investing!
